means.example-sentence: I'm very tired from working all day and want to take a good rest now.
means.sentence-jp: 私は一日中働きすぎてとても疲れていて, 今は十分な休息をとりたい。

cloze.maskedText: I'm very ____ working all day and want to take a good rest now.

notes: 『〜でへとへとに疲れる』は, be tired [worn] out from [with] ~, be exhausted from [with] ~, be used up from [with] ~ などと言う。
